editorial.name: Mixo
editorial.descriptionZh: 面向小微企业的 AI 建站工具：用一句话描述业务，直接产出带联系表单、博客、SEO 与 GEO / AI search 优化的整站，绑上自有域名即可发布。
editorial.takeawayZh: 一句话描述业务，生成带表单和博客的企业整站
editorial.noteZh: 首屏粉色大标题 Build a professional website with AI in minutes.，下面小字 Free plan available • No credit card required，右侧模拟浏览器窗里演示着 Landscaping business in Austin 和 Building your website…。往下 Built with Mixo. 是一排真实客户站：PayYou、Holistic Oncology、Bosworth Law Firm、Renovate Pro、CraftiPanda、Temen Bulu、Laughing Horse Arts。再往下 Everything your business needs to get online. 把 pages、contact forms、blog、SEO、GEO / AI search optimization 一次列全，并配 Get enquiries from your website. 讲 enquiry tracking 与 integrations。
editorial.pricing: Freemium（首屏写 Free plan available，付费档在 /pricing）

reasons.statement: 交付物是可上线的整站：正文写 Mixo builds a complete business website in seconds - including pages, contact forms, blog, SEO, GEO / AI search optimization，另有 custom domains 与 GDPR 页面。
归 site-app-builders 而非设计素材类：站内 /features/ai-website-builder、/website-builder 卖的是建站过程本身，/compare/wix-alternative 一类页面也是把它放进建站平台里横向比较。
